outcome: established that all the measures and procedures were lawful and in accordance with legal powers and professional rules
supporting_quote: on 20 April 1995, the MIA had appointed a “working group” ( delovna skupina ) consisting of officers from the Slovenj Gradec Police and the MIA to assess the lawfulness of the procedures carried out by the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police. ... the working group established that all the measures and procedures were lawful and in accordance with legal powers and professional rules.

deciding_body: the Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
outcome: the applicant’s criminal complaint was dismissed
supporting_quote: On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor issued a decision dismissing the applicant’s criminal complaint.

outcome: decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant
supporting_quote: On 8 May 1997, further to a proposal of the investigating judge, the Slovenj Gradec District Court decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant.

outcome: the appeal was allowed and a criminal investigation was opened against the applicant
supporting_quote: On 4 December 1997 the Maribor Higher Court upheld her appeal finding that, despite the shortcomings mentioned in the first-instance decision, there were sufficient grounds for suspicion that the applicant had committed the alleged offence. Accordingly, it changed the first-instance court’s decision and opened a criminal investigation against the applicant.

outcome: ordered the exclusion of certain documents from the case-file
supporting_quote: On 17 March 1998 the criminal investigation was concluded with the investigating judge’s decision ordering the exclusion of certain documents from the case-file

outcome: the applicant's objection to the indictment was rejected
supporting_quote: His objection was rejected by the Slovenj Gradec District Court on 16 February 1999.
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant.

outcome: the judgment was quashed and the case was remitted for retrial
supporting_quote: on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial.

outcome: the applicant was convicted and sentenced to 3 months’ imprisonment, suspended for 3 years
supporting_quote: By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged and sentenced him to 3 months’ imprisonment, suspended for 3 years.

outcome: the conviction was upheld but the judgment was amended regarding costs
supporting_quote: On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction but amended the judgment with respect to the costs of the proceedings.

outcome: the applicant was ordered to pay an additional sum for witness costs
supporting_quote: Lastly, on 11 October 2001 the Slovenj Gradec District Court ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses heard during the proceedings.
